items.item_text: CPHQ or CPPS certification
A Bachelor’s degree
A Master’s degree
1-2 years of quality, patient safety, or risk management experience
Experience in working with large data and analytical support
Experience with system management
As the Patient Safety Analyst, you will support various patient safety and quality improvement initiatives, helping to prevent harm to our patients. You will be responsible for:
Reviewing and analyzing data related to patient safety practices, incidents, and outcomes
Preparing moderately complex reports to support the Patient Safety team
Managing and supporting systems used by the Patient Safety team, such as the SOFI event reporting system and electronic systems for documenting significant event reviews
Handling system configurations, user mapping, tracking optimization requests, and troubleshooting concerns
Supporting the Good Catch and Zero Harm recognition programs
Collaborating with Patient Safety leadership to provide system support and generate reports for the Culture of Safety Survey
We are seeking a detail-oriented, self-directed individual with:

the final candidate who accepts an offer of employment will be required to disclose if they have been subject to any final administrative or judicial decisions within the last seven years determining that they committed any misconduct; or have filed an appeal of a finding of substantiated misconduct with a previous employer.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to review and interpret patient safety data
Note: Skills may be subject to test.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with Patient Safety leadership and team members
Proficient in basic computer skills using an EHR, Microsoft Office Suite
Ability to be resourceful, a critical thinker, and have sound judgement when meeting the service needs of others
Ability to identify opportunities to improve quality outcomes
